# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting SpecWithCode or infrastructure we operate to
[anton.abyzov@gmail.com](mailto:anton.abyzov@gmail.com). Please do not disclose them publicly
until we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

Include a description of the issue and its impact, the affected version or component, reproduction
steps or a minimal proof of concept, and how to reach you. We aim to acknowledge complete reports
within one business day.
